notes.title: Patch Note March 29th
notes.content:
-Fixed Auto Pause.
-Changed the Revolver to autohit normally instead of the 6shot.
-Fixed the mob cast time to be exactly 0.25sec.
-Fixed some UI bugs.

notes.title: Path Note March 25th
notes.content:
-WASD Camera movement
-Improved stone cold visibility
-Added an option for high cursor contrast visibility
-Fixed a bug where you would kill all mobs in a round and die right after
-Modified winchester RETREAT perk
-Added heals throughout the map
-You can now skip to any rank you have reached

notes.title: Patch Note March
notes.content: Replaced the long fort captures by hordes of mobs rushing. Fixed bugs.
